schemes.subject: English Grammar
schemes.identity_quote: GRAMMAR SCHEME OF WORK FOR PRIMARY FIVE TERM ONE 2024

objectives: Identify irregular verbs and distinguish past tense from past participle forms.
activities: Identify irregular verbs and construct oral sentences.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

objectives: Explain the tense, identify helping verbs and construct present-perfect sentences.
activities: Construct affirmative, negative and interrogative sentences orally and in writing.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

objectives: Identify helping verbs and form present-perfect passive sentences.
activities: Answer oral and written questions and change sentences into the passive.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

objectives: Distinguish IF and main clauses and construct first-conditional sentences.
activities: Answer oral and written questions about IF1 clauses.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

objectives: Explain the use of the past simple and form affirmative, negative and interrogative sentences.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

objectives: Identify past-simple passive helping verbs and construct passive sentences.
activities: Answer oral and written questions on the past-simple passive.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

lessons.subtopic: The use of since, for and from
objectives: Explain uses of since, for and from and construct sentences with them.
activities: Discuss examples and answer oral and written questions.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

The use of

objectives: Explain the past continuous and construct sentences with was/were and -ing verbs.
activities: Answer oral and written questions about the tense.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

objectives: Describe how must and mustn't are used and construct sentences.
activities: Discuss modal verbs and answer oral and written questions.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

lessons.subtopic: The use of a, an and the
objectives: Identify the uses of a, an and the.
activities: Discuss the articles and their uses.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

The use of a,
an and the

lessons.subtopic: The use of a, an and the
objectives: Choose suitable articles to complete sentences.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

The use of a,
an and the

lessons.subtopic: The use of some relative pronouns
objectives: Explain relative pronouns and construct sentences with who, whom, whose, which and that.
activities: Construct sentences with relative pronouns and respond to questions.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

The use of
some relative
pronouns

objectives: Define adverbs, identify examples and form adverbs from adjectives.
activities: Identify adverbs and practice their formation.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

lessons.subtopic: The position of adverbs in a sentence
objectives: Explain adverb placement and position adverbs correctly in sentences.
activities: Reorder sentences to position adverbs correctly.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

objectives: Identify classes of adverbs and give examples for each class.
activities: Classify examples into manner, time, duration, frequency and place.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

objectives: Identify degrees of comparison and form comparative and superlative adverbs.
activities: Complete sentences using appropriate degrees of adverbs.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

objectives: Form adverbs correctly from given words.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

objectives: Define question tags, distinguish positive and negative statements and complete tags.
activities: Construct question tags for affirmative and negative statements.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

objectives: Complete statements with suitable special question tags.
activities: Practice tags formed with am, used to, shall, will, need and needn't.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

objectives: Explain the present simple and form affirmative, negative and interrogative sentences.
activities: Construct present-simple sentences and respond to questions.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

objectives: Identify helping verbs and write present-simple passive sentences.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

lessons.subtopic: The use of so that and in order
objectives: Construct sentences with so that and in order.
activities: Discuss the structural patterns and form sentences.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

lessons.subtopic: The use of prefer...to and like...more than
objectives: Construct correct sentences expressing preferences with the given patterns.
activities: Form oral and written sentences using the preference patterns.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

lessons.subtopic: The use of while and when
objectives: Distinguish while and when and construct sentences with both.
activities: Compare uses and compose example sentences.
lessons.assessment: Oral and written questions or exercises on the stated subtopic.

objectives: Construct statements and questions in all three forms.
activities: Revise by composing affirmative, negative and interrogative sentences.
